title: Compile budget: the A2A HTTP stack off the path into susi-gawd
goal: susi-gawd compiles without waiting for the A2A HTTP stack (tokio -> hyper -> axum -> ra2a -> susi-gawd-a2a). susi-gawd uses no item of susi-gawd-a2a; it only re-exported the tier, and the daemon is the one caller (it serves port 9094 through susi_gawd_a2a::server::serve). The dependency moves from susi-gawd to susi-daemon, no crate is added and no source line of the A2A server changes, so bearer auth, host_only, bind_address and the A2A conformance behaviour are unchanged by construction. The pillar reach ceilings drop to their measured values while the host binary keeps compiling the same units; the measured critical path before and after is recorded in .agents/build-time.jsonl and docs/lean-core.md.
acceptance: cargo test -p susi-gawd-a2a --lib --offline --locked passes: the agent card, the per-capability skills, the JSON-RPC round trip through the real ra2a router, the A2A 1.0 method names, the standard error codes on / and /stream, the bearer challenge and the VC-201-087/092 task semantics, all with susi-gawd no longer depending on susi-gawd-a2a.
